title: Glowing ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="34" fill="#FFD966" opacity="0.12"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="26" fill="#FFD966" opacity="0.12"/>
  
  <!-- Cone (waffle) -->
  <polygon points="35,55 65,55 50,95" fill="#D99A3E"/>
  <!-- Cone lighter ridge lines -->
  <line x1="38" y1="60" x2="62" y2="60" stroke="#F2C16E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="66" x2="60" y2="66" stroke="#F2C16E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="72" x2="58" y2="72" stroke="#F2C16E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="78" x2="56" y2="78" stroke="#F2C16E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="84" x2="54" y2="84" stroke="#F2C16E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Cone cross lines -->
  <line x1="43" y1="55" x2="48" y2="70" stroke="#F2C16E" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="55" x2="50" y2="85" stroke="#F2C16E" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="57" y1="55" x2="52" y2="70" stroke="#F2C16E" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  
  <!-- Bottom scoop (strawberry pink) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="19" ry="14" fill="#FF7BA8"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="44" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#FFB3CC" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Top scoop (mint green) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="16" ry="13" fill="#7BE8B0"/>
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="28" rx="6" ry="4.5" fill="#B5F5D8" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Cherry on top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="17" r="6" fill="#FF4D6D"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="15" r="2" fill="#FF99B0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M50,11 Q54,6 58,8" stroke="#5CDB7A" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Cherry stem -->
  <path d="M50,11 Q53,5 57,6" stroke="#5CDB7A" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Glow outlines around scoops -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="19" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#FFB3CC" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="16" ry="13" fill="none" stroke="#B5F5D8" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Sprinkle details -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="30" r="1.2" fill="#FFD966"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="36" r="1.2" fill="#FF7BA8"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#7BE8B0"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#FFD966"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="38" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- Drip from scoops -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="55" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FF7BA8"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="54" rx="2.5" ry="3.5" fill="#7BE8B0"/>
</svg>
